purpose: Show that a capability-first route can leave the scientific-agent ontology and surface adjacent knowledge-navigation systems without requiring their product names in advance.

name_free_intents: local graph backlinks notes personal knowledge management graph view
personal knowledge management backlinks graph notes local graph
note taking knowledge graph backlinks local graph visualization

surfaced_examples.rakl_use: candidate analogue for reverse provenance/support navigation; scientific semantics remain RAKL-specific
evidence that local graph interaction is a broader design pattern rather than an Obsidian-specific invention
adjacent research literature for knowledge-state representation/management prior-art review

finding: The earlier miss was not evidence that the information was unavailable. A function-first route using capability terms can surface the relevant neighborhood. The failure was therefore a search-policy/coverage failure, not merely missing product-name memory.
limits: A successful demonstration query does not prove complete external discovery coverage.
Graph-navigation similarity does not establish semantic equivalence to RAKL's contextual scientific authority system.
This route must be repeated prospectively on future unknown concepts to earn method-promotion evidence.
